intro: We hold a recorded total fee for {{count}} published BEd colleges in India. This guide puts the top BEd colleges in India with fees for 2026 in one place, so you can compare government and private options before you apply.

After any ranked colleges with a fee on file, the list is ordered by recorded fee, lowest first. Read the programme name, because some cards show a B.El.Ed or an integrated B.Ed–M.Ed rather than a two-year B.Ed.
listLead: The first cards are mostly public universities and Delhi colleges with a lower recorded fee. Check the duration on the card; a four-year B.El.Ed and a one- or two-year B.Ed are not priced the same way.
snapshot: Across the {{feeN}} published colleges on this list, the median recorded total fee is {{feeMedian}}. The middle half of colleges sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
{{public}} of the colleges are public and {{private}} are private. Uttar Pradesh, Haryana and West Bengal have the most listings, with Lucknow, Kolkata and Delhi appearing often.

Fees under ₹10,000 are treated as data errors and are kept off this list. A few Hindu College and Banaras Hindu University B.Ed rows in our file were in that group and should not be read as the official fee.
firstCollegesLead: Rabindra Bharati University has a recorded B.Ed (Hons) fee of ₹13,500 for two years in our files. Jadavpur University's recorded B.Ed fee is ₹15,260, but the duration in our table is one year, so confirm the official period.

Gargi College and Miranda House appear with Bachelor of Elementary Education fees of ₹14,200 and ₹19,000, each over four years in our records. Those look like an annual figure; use the college notice before you compare them with a two-year B.Ed.

sections.heading: What to confirm on a B.Ed fee notice
paragraphs: B.Ed admissions are usually run through a state or university entrance test, and eligibility is set by the National Council for Teacher Education and the university. In our records, the Uttar Pradesh JEE B.Ed is the exam most often linked to this list.
Always match the programme: a B.Ed, a B.El.Ed, a B.Ed Special Education, or an integrated B.Ed–M.Ed will have different durations and fees.

compare.heading: How to compare the top BEd colleges in India with fees
paragraphs: Compare like with like: a four-year B.El.Ed at a Delhi college and a two-year B.Ed at a state university should not be ranked on the raw fee alone.
Use these checks on the official notice:
bullets: The exact award and duration, and whether the recorded fee is for one year or the full programme.
Whether the college is NCTE-recognised for the programme you want, and which entrance test it uses.
Government versus private status, because the median of {{feeMedian}} hides a wide gap between the two.
Hostel and other charges, which are often listed separately for teacher-education programmes.

faqs.question: How many B.Ed colleges in India have fees listed here?
faqs.answer: {{count}} published BEd colleges have a recorded total fee in our records. Colleges without a quotable fee, and rows under ₹10,000, are not placed in this list.

faqs.question: What is the typical B.Ed fee in India in 2026?
faqs.answer: Among the {{feeN}} published colleges here, the median recorded fee is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half falls between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}. Confirm whether a figure is for one year or the full programme.

faqs.question: Why do some cards show B.El.Ed instead of B.Ed?
faqs.answer: A B.El.Ed is a four-year undergraduate programme in elementary education, not a two-year B.Ed. Gargi College and Miranda House appear here with B.El.Ed fees, so read the programme name before you compare cost.

faqs.question: Which exam is used for B.Ed admission?
faqs.answer: It depends on the state and the university. In our records, the Uttar Pradesh JEE B.Ed is linked to nine colleges on this list, and GGSIPU CET to one. Check the official notice for the campus you want.

faqs.question: Why are some well-known university B.Ed fees missing?
faqs.answer: Fees under ₹10,000 are treated as data errors. In our file, some Hindu College and Banaras Hindu University B.Ed rows fell below that floor, so they are not quoted here. Use the official fee notice.
